value.rationale: The long-lag autocovariance of collective coherence is a natural dynamic observable, not determined by an instantaneous stationary order-parameter distribution. It has a mathematically sharp critical signature at the classical OA threshold K=2sigma: exp(-lambda t)t^-3/2 rather than an off-critical pure exponential or uncentered t^-1/2 response. The positive exact incomplete-gamma coefficient and explicit exceptional zero path make the classification usable in temporal inference and comparison with reset-ensemble simulations. Although the covariance reduction itself is standard, quantifying the critical cancellation and all regimes is a motivated exact invariant, not an arbitrary parameter slice, mere normalization, or a known table recomputation.

final_claim: For sigma>0, K>=0, lambda>0, 0<rho0<=1, globally Poisson-reset deterministic Lorentzian Ott–Antonsen coherence f obeys C(t)=exp(-lambda t)Cov(f(A),f(A+t)), A~Exp(lambda). For K<2sigma, C(t)~B_- exp(-(lambda+sigma-K/2)t) with B_->0; for K>2sigma and rho0 unequal to q=sqrt(1-2sigma/K), C(t)~B_+ exp(-(lambda+K-2sigma)t) with B_+>0, while rho0=q gives identically zero covariance. For K=2sigma, C(t)~B_c exp(-lambda t)t^(-3/2), B_c=exp(z)/(4sigma sqrt(lambda))*[(z+1)Gamma(1/2,z)-Gamma(3/2,z)]>0, z=lambda/(2sigma rho0^2). All parameters fixed, t→infinity.
limitations: Continuum infinite-population Lorentzian OA manifold with a deterministic fixed initial coherence rho0 and shared Poisson reset only; neither finite-size fluctuations nor local resets are covered.
All fixed-parameter t→infinity expansions may fail uniformity as K→2sigma, lambda→0 or rho0→0.
The prior OA flow, stationary marginal and renewal splitting are standard; precise novelty is restricted to the full centered lag covariance asymptotic.
